correctness.rationale: Fresh exact 2^18-mask enumeration gave 714 nonempty directed-linear-forest simplices in dimensions 0..4: 18,108,264,252,72, with 2376 covers. Independent matching reproduced 341 pairs and only critical cells (one 0, nineteen 3, twelve 4); Hasse DAG checked acyclic and integral Morse d4=0. With no 1/2 critical cells, Hurewicz proves wedge 19 S³ vee 12 S⁴. Independently mod2 boundary ranks (17,91,173,60) and rational signed 252x72 top boundary rank60; 72 full automorphisms yield character class values matching RESULT and top invariant0, H3 invariant1. Source scripts inspect both independent pivot construction and 72-element signed action.
residual_risks: Exact finite verification cannot imply an unasserted parametrized generalization; all conclusions bounded as stated.
